summary_1line: After the war, grieving Yudhishthira confesses to sages that victory feels hollow, especially after learning Karna—whom they killed—was secretly his elder brother.

image_candidates.scene_text: On the banks of the Ganga, Yudhishthira sits surrounded by sages and grieving kin after offering water-rites to the fallen of the great war.
Kunti places her infant son in a small basket and releases him into the flowing Ganga under the rising sun.
Yudhishthira, pale with sorrow, recounts to Narada how the mighty Karna they killed was unknowingly their own elder brother.
